plan_id.description: ID of the plan to execute

dry_run.description: If true, preview what would happen without actually executing operations

stop_on_error.description: If true, stop processing remaining operations after the first failure.

verify_after.description: If true, verify each successful operation by checking expected filesystem state.

idempotency_key.description: Optional replay-protection key. Repeated executions with the same key return the first result.
